question:
The following pie diagram shows the total expenditure (in percentage) incurred by 'X' in one month. Answer the given question based on the pie diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96d00fc763c864208664e3cc66fcf1dd40f5b42a6ff012db4f9f2cb9364f4332.png] 

The expenditure incurred on education is as much as that incurred on:
solution:
Calculation:

Share of Food and Other expenses = 12.5 + 25 = 37.5%

Share of education expenses = 37.5%

**∴ The expenditure incurred on education is as much as that incurred on Food and Other expenses.**
